FREELANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Freelance Services Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of May 4, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Larkspur Hollow Tea Company, Inc., a Vermont corporation ("Client"), and Rowan T. Ellery, an individual doing business as Ellery Copy Studio ("Consultant").

1. Services

1.1 Consultant will write, edit and deliver the copy for Client's new website, consisting of a home page, an about page, six product category pages and one wholesale inquiry page, as described in the project outline the parties exchanged by email on April 27, 2026 (the "Services").

1.2 Consultant will deliver a first draft of all pages by June 1, 2026, and Client will send one consolidated set of comments within ten business days after receiving it.

1.3 Consultant will deliver final copy within ten business days after receiving Client's comments.

1.4 If Client asks for work outside the Services, the parties will agree on the scope and fee for that work in writing before Consultant begins it.

2. Fees and Payment

2.1 Client will pay Consultant a fixed fee of $6,800 for the Services.

2.2 Consultant will invoice $3,400 when the first draft is delivered and $3,400 when the final copy is delivered.

2.3 Client will pay each invoice within 15 days after receiving it, by check or by bank transfer to the account shown on the invoice.

2.4 Client will reimburse Consultant for reasonable out-of-pocket expenses that Client approves in writing before they are incurred, and Consultant will include receipts with the invoice for those expenses.

3. Ownership

3.1 Client will own the final copy delivered under this Agreement once Client has paid for it in full.

3.2 Consultant keeps all rights in the templates, style guides, research notes, writing methods and other materials Consultant owned or developed before the Effective Date or outside the Services.

3.3 Consultant may show the published website copy in Consultant's portfolio after Client launches the website.

4. Working Relationship

4.1 Consultant is an independent contractor, and nothing in this Agreement makes Consultant an employee, partner or agent of Client.

4.2 Consultant decides how, when and where to perform the Services, and provides Consultant's own equipment.

4.3 Consultant is responsible for Consultant's own taxes on the fees paid under this Agreement.

4.4 Consultant may take on work for other clients during and after this Agreement.

5. Confidentiality

5.1 Each party will keep confidential any non-public business information the other party shares in connection with the Services and will use it only to perform or receive the Services.

5.2 This obligation does not cover information that is already public, that the receiving party already knew, or that the receiving party is required by law to disclose.

6. Term and Termination

6.1 This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and ends when Consultant delivers the final copy and Client pays the final invoice.

6.2 Either party may end this Agreement at any time by giving the other party 14 days' written notice.

6.3 If this Agreement ends before the Services are complete, Client will pay Consultant for the work performed through the end date at Consultant's rate of $95 per hour, up to the unpaid balance of the fixed fee, and Consultant will deliver all work completed to that date.

7. Disputes

7.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Vermont.

7.2 The parties will first try in good faith to resolve any disagreement by talking it through.

7.3 Any dispute that the parties cannot resolve will be decided by the state courts located in Addersley County, Vermont.

8. General

8.1 Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and sent by email to the addresses below the signatures, with a copy by mail if the other party asks for one.

8.2 This Agreement may be changed only by a written document signed by both Client and Consultant.

8.3 This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties about the Services and replaces the earlier project outline to the extent the two differ.

8.4 Neither party may transfer this Agreement to someone else without the other party's written consent.

8.5 This Agreement may be signed electronically and in counterparts.
